text_block_list.text:
Biwa Hayahide is selecting a dessert at
the lunch
buffet, when...

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Oh, Trainer! In front of you is just what I
was
looking for—our legendary Extra
Sweet Banana
Cake!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Or... maybe not. Looks like they're all
out.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
You can't mean to tell me you've never
heard of
it! It's the crème de la crème of
the school dessert
world.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Bananas have anti-inflammatory
properties, which
means they're great for
injuries. I always try to eat
at least one
before I start training.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Of course, it also tastes delectable!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
The combination of whipped cream and
ripe
bananas is simply to die for! As soon
as it touches
your tongue, the sensa—

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Ahem! Unfortunately, it seems they're all
out. I
suppose I'll just need to find
myself another
dessert today.
